title: raphionacme splendens subsp. bingeri

The plant is reported to have various health benefits, including its potential to lower blood pressure, and alleviate pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been identified as alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its therapeutic potential.
